Irregular: 2008-09 folder has space 'XXVII%20OPM%20(2008-09)' and suffix _f1bp.pdf; 2020-21 single file XXXIX_fb.pdf
notes: Official SPM site, static listing (Arquivo > Provas) from XXVI OPM 2007/08. Categoria A = lower (8-9th grade). No Portuguese IMO selection tests published (selection via OPM + training; AoPS only).

competition: Estonian Mathematical Olympiad - Final Round (selected problems, English booklet 'Estonian Math Competitions')
notes: Official Univ. of Tartu booklet given to IMO leaders; one PDF per school year contains selected open-contest problems, SELECTED final-round problems (not necessarily all, grades 10-12 and 7-9) and ALL IMO team selection contest problems, with full solutions. Key = spring year. Full Estonian-language originals also on olympiaadid.ut.ee (not checked).
All TST problems included in the same yearly booklet as the final (see Estonia final entry for URLs).

competition: Latvian State Mathematics Olympiad (Valsts matematikas olimpiade, VOL, grades 9-12)
pattern: https://www.nms.lu.lv/fileadmin/user_upload/lu_portal/projekti/nms.lu.lv/Arhivs/Olimpiades/VOL/{2000-2010|2010-2020|2020-2030}/ + irregular names: {N}repol_uzd.pdf (2005-2013, N=year-1950), vol_{N}_uzd.pdf / vol_66_3p_uzd.pdf / VOL_{N}_uzd_9_12_klase.pdf (later); solutions {N}repol_atr.pdf, VOL_75_uzd_ATR_9_12_klase.pdf
notes: Official LU A. Liepa correspondence math school; static table, scrape hrefs (filenames irregular; 2020 is .docx). Older years also in printed compilations under Gramatas/Uzd_krajumi/. No Latvian IMO TST published.

notes: Official Vilnius Univ. MIF site (WordPress, static). Upload-folder part of URL varies -> scrape listing.

urls.2025: https://drive.google.com/uc?export=download&id=1IhgO5GY--KlohX0l75yeAV0wITw9jZth (CHECK: page shows a dash char, likely '--' or '-')

notes: Files are Google Drive links (listing gives drive.google.com/file/d/{ID}/view; converted here to uc?export=download&id= form for PowerShell). 2020-2024 not listed. 2025 ID contains a dash that WebFetch rendered as an en-dash -> re-scrape the exact href. 2025 solutions ID: 1Fjetz__TROeuHtGdWGe1oModBqzLC80A. Finnish IMO selection tests not published (valmennus letters at https://matematiikkakilpailut.fi/valmennus/ only).

pattern: https://www.matematikksenteret.no/sites/default/files/attachments/Abelkonkurransen/abel-oppgaver/abel_{YY1}{YY2}_f_prob_{nb|nn|en}.pdf (1992/93-2019/20), solutions abel_{YY1}{YY2}_f_sol_nb.pdf; 2020/21: Abel2020_finaleoppgaver_{lang}.pdf; 2021/22-2024/25: Abel{Y1}_f_{lang}.pdf, solutions Abel{Y1}_fl_nb.pdf; 2025/26 under .../files/images/Abelkonkurransen/Abelkonkurransen2526/

pattern: https://www.georgmohr.dk/gmopg/gm{YY}opg.pdf (verified 2005, 2015, 2026); solutions https://www.georgmohr.dk/gmopg/gm{YY}loes.pdf (verified 2025); grading notes gm{YY}retvejl.pdf; 1991-2010 compiled with solutions: https://www.georgmohr.dk/noter/GM1991-2010.pdf

listing_page: https://www.stae.is/stak/keppnin{AUTUMNYEAR} (e.g. keppnin2023 = 2023-2024 season); old: 'Keppnin 1999-2008', 'Keppnin 1984-1998' linked from same menu; http://stae.is/stak/keppnin (redirect loop for WebFetch)
contents: statements and/or solutions (Lausnir) - varies by year
notes: Official Icelandic Math Society. Filenames fully irregular (e.g. 'Úrslitakeppni_2024.pdf', 'rslitakeppni_2025.pdf', 'Lausnir-Urslitakeppni.pdf', 'lokakeppnin2016_lausnir.pdf') and contain spaces/accents -> scrape each season page. Some years only list the solutions file for the final. Key = year of final (spring). IS versions of Nordic problems at georgmohr.dk/nmcperm/probl/{YEAR}/is.pdf. No IMO TST published.

competition: Cyprus Mathematical Olympiad (KMO) - B-C Lyceum paper
notes: Official CyMS; per-year pages with PDFs on cdn.b3web.xyz (filenames with timestamps, scrape each page). This is a broad national contest, NOT the IMO-selection track; for olympiad-level see Cyprus selection competitions entry. 2023 URL is the direct B-C Lyceum PDF; solutions: optimizedOLYMPIAD_2023_Solutions.pdf1681721535.pdf.

competition: Selection competitions for IMO/BMO/EGMO (A', B', C', D' Diagonismos Epilogis, Lyceum/'Megaloi')
notes: Official static listing; 2-4 selection tests per year each with papers + solutions links on cdn.b3web.xyz (timestamped filenames, scrape). URLs above = last listed test of each year.

Ministry of Education site has only early-stage (A1) practice tests (pattern meyda.education.gov.il/files/Science-olympic/math/mathA1_{YEAR}__test.pdf). Grossman olympiad (Technion) posts only results reports (noam-math.technion.ac.il/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/report{a}-{b}.pdf, no problems). Weizmann IMT site blocked by robots. No official final/TST archive found; AoPS only.
